failure_patterns.canonical_label_error_detail: The current semantic evaluator returns aggregate TP/FP/FN totals but no per-label confusion matrix. The saved per-witness breakdown preserves TP/FP/FN counts; it does not claim complete label identities for false labels on base-matched occurrences.

joint_c1_1_c2_acceptance_assessment.feature_d_status: remains blocked/unstarted; no milestone status was changed
reasoning: The fidelity-checked arm has effects 14 TP / 20 FP / 9 FN, dependencies 5 / 0 / 2, and canonical labels 15 / 3 / 15.
Field errors recur across the cohort: condition 0/14, trigger 0/23, result 0/30, recipient 10/30, direction 14/30, and magnitude 3/21.

The evaluator has no adjudicated typed-relationship denominator because the source-only oracle cannot provide generated occurrence/relationship IDs; the arm also reports 3 unresolved relationship attachments.

C1.1 source capture and slice identity are verified, but the semantic evaluator reports all 15 C1.1 fidelity dimensions as unknown for all seven witnesses; this run therefore does not establish joint C1.1/C2 acceptance.

Unlabeled outputs on formula, child, resource, and metadata text recur across witnesses; one deploy_zone false positive and one direct_damage false positive show unsupported behavior is not consistently fail-closed.
